planting_photo.prompt:
Surgical edit of this one approved photograph for a printed gardening book. The ONLY edit is to the seam between dark compost and green grass on the sides and near end of the same 1.2-metre-wide no-dig bed. Fresh compost laid on grass is friable. At present it has a stencil-cut outline. Lose the ruler-sharp seam in a few small, irregular places: along the right side let three or four shallow, asymmetrical little tongues of fine brown compost feather 2–5 cm into the grass; a few thumbnail-sized dark crumbs, small woody fragments and finer grains lodge between grass blades just beside them. A couple of strays at the near short end and on the visible left edge below the seedling tray. Most of the perimeter is quite tidy, plenty of clean green grass in between these modest spills. Here and there blades poke up through the thin scattering, individual in-focus and soft-edged grains diminishing away from the bed. Concentrate the most legible of these subtle spills at the near right so this reads as natural even when printed 45mm wide. The shape is still the SAME straight-sided rectangle connecting the same fixed corner stones. No curved boundary, no continuous brown halo, no heaps, large stones, extra borders, or mud-splattered whole lawn. Think just a small forkful slumped locally over the side when it was levelled.

Everything else in the supplied photograph is already approved and must be reproduced exactly, as in a pixel-preserving local retouch: keep the same John, especially the approved tucked, receding chin in near-profile, same pose/eyes/body/checked shirt, the same FIVE lettuces in one near row including the one at his fingertips, same spinach and red-stemmed beetroot covering the far half, same module tray, same compost surface within the bed, marker stones and lawn outside the small spills, same greenhouse, colour grading, camera crop and lighting. Do not change the locations, proportions, scene content, or composition. One full-bleed square photograph, photographic grain and resolution of the original, no text.
planting_photo.local_change: Small irregular spills of compost into the grassy margins of the rectangular bed.
